TL;DR: I think that Net Neutrality risks a government take-over of the internet and large ISPs would have the greatest influence on the resulting government regulations. The real problem is a lack of competition.

The majority of people I interact with on Voat immediately think that Net Neutrality is absolutely good and anyone who opposes it is a shill for the ISPs.

I want to make it clear at the start that I think internet throttling sucks and can even lead to censorship. In no way do I support this. Blocking this is a very attractive proposition that anyone can get behind. Who wouldn’t want that? Net Neutrality appears to promise this by limiting what ISPs can get away with.

However, this argument is exceedingly oversimplified and short-sighted. Net Neutrality would ultimately do more harm than good. Opening the door further to government control of the internet is very dangerous. Net Neutrality would set this precedent. We can already see how government regulations are screwing us. They already end up favoring the big ISPs, blocking new ISPs from entering the market. This is why there is barely any competition now. This is why these ISPs can treat us like shit. More regulation would exacerbate this problem.

Who has the greatest influence on government regulations? The companies with the most money. Who are these companies? The same shitty ISPs that already treat us like slaves. These ISPs would inevitably shape new regulations to suit their interests and further strengthen their monopoly. Effectively, they would co-opt the precedent of government intervention that Net Neutrality sets and bend new regulations to their will. It would further classic crony capitalism. Whatever industry the government interferes with goes to shit. Just look at what Obamacare and the previous decades of creeping regulation have done to the health industry. We have less competition and more useless government regulations that harm the consumer.

The real solution is to roll back regulations that already exist and allow for greater free-market competition. The more choices the consumer has, the better off the consumer is. If one provider is treating its customers like shit, another provider can compete by offering a better product. If one provider is throttling packets, then its customers can take their business to another provider who doesn’t. It would push the industry to actually serve the customer.

Basically, I fear that Net Neutrality would ultimately end up in a crony capitalistic strangle-hold on the industry. Is this fear unjustified? What do you think?
